title: Remove a text prefix
summary: Bash: Remove a text prefix. Use the prefix note instead.
introduction: The # expansion removes a matching prefix from a value. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Remove a text prefix with Bash

blocks.text: Use a terminal with Bash. Save each example as lesson.sh and run bash lesson.sh. These practice scripts do not delete or change files.
The # prefix form removes notes from the front, leaving .txt.
